name: Labor Insurance (勞工保險)
authority: Labor Insurance Act articles 6, 8, 9, 13–15; Enforcement Rules articles 27, 28-1 and 33. Ordinary-risk premium rate 11.5%, shared 20% employee, 70% employer and 10% government. Registered continuing cover remains chargeable after age 65. Apply the declared insured salary grade and covered days on a thirty-day calendar; round each share once after day proration. Variable wages use an independently recorded three-month-average declaration. Salary changes do not automatically change the insured grade; notified adjustments take effect on the first of the following month. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0007758.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0014162.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006928.html 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 — the government subsidises the insured worker's own share by the certificate's severity (100/50/25%); BLI computes the subsidy on the worker's unrounded share and rounds it to the whole dollar on its own, and the worker is withheld the rounded share less the rounded subsidy — BLI's worked example (勞動部勞工保險局納保組 許晉慶, 〈身心障礙勞工保險費減免〉, 台灣勞工季刊 第44期 p.72–73, https://www.mol.gov.tw/media/q5cjfwu3/%E6%B4%BB%E7%94%A8%E6%B3%95%E8%A6%8F.pdf): 輕度, grade 28,800, LI 9%: (28,800×9%×20%) − (28,800×9%×20%×25%) = 518 − 130 = 388; EI 1%: 58 − 14 = 44. Subsidy standards 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?PCode=D0050090). The employer share is unchanged.

elections.description: Enter the insurer-confirmed monthly grade. The registration dates are its effective dates, not the salary-change or notification dates. elections.label: Disability premium subsidy (%)
elections.description: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 and 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法: the government pays 100% (極重度/重度), 50% (中度) or 25% (輕度) of the insured worker's own share. Record the percentage on the worker's disability certificate; zero when none.

elections.label: 育嬰留職停薪續保 (parental-leave continuation)
elections.description: 性別平等工作法 §16(2): 受僱者於育嬰留職停薪期間，得繼續參加原有之社會保險，原由雇主負擔之保險費，免予繳納；原由受僱者負擔之保險費，得遞延三年繳納. Record it on the declaration dated for the 育嬰留職停薪 period when the worker applied to continue (育嬰留職停薪實施辦法 §2(2)(5)): CONTINUED, or DEFERRED where the worker chose to pay their own share up to three years later. Either way payroll charges nothing for those days: the employer's share is not payable (the government bears it, BLI FAQ https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006915.html), and the insurer bills the worker's own share to the worker directly (勞保局: 寄出…育嬰續保保險費繳款單予被保險人繳納, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/20250/; 健保署: 繳款單由健保署寄發被保險人). NONE, the default, is no continuation: continuation is only on the worker's application (§16(2) 得繼續參加; 實施辦法 §2(2)(5)), so a worker not on the leave, or one who did not apply, is NONE.

elections.label: Disability premium subsidy (%)
elections.description: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 and 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法: the government pays 100% (極重度/重度), 50% (中度) or 25% (輕度) of the insured worker's own share. Record the percentage on the worker's disability certificate; zero when none.

elections.label: 育嬰留職停薪續保 (parental-leave continuation)
elections.description: 性別平等工作法 §16(2): 受僱者於育嬰留職停薪期間，得繼續參加原有之社會保險，原由雇主負擔之保險費，免予繳納；原由受僱者負擔之保險費，得遞延三年繳納. Record it on the declaration dated for the 育嬰留職停薪 period when the worker applied to continue (育嬰留職停薪實施辦法 §2(2)(5)): CONTINUED, or DEFERRED where the worker chose to pay their own share up to three years later. Either way payroll charges nothing for those days: the employer's share is not payable (the government bears it, BLI FAQ https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006915.html), and the insurer bills the worker's own share to the worker directly (勞保局: 寄出…育嬰續保保險費繳款單予被保險人繳納, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/20250/; 健保署: 繳款單由健保署寄發被保險人). NONE, the default, is no continuation: continuation is only on the worker's application (§16(2) 得繼續參加; 實施辦法 §2(2)(5)), so a worker not on the leave, or one who did not apply, is NONE.

name: National Health Insurance (全民健康保險)
authority: National Health Insurance Act articles 18, 27, 29 and 30; Enforcement Rules article 52. Regular premiums use the declared insured amount at the month-end insuring unit. The employee pays 30% of the 5.17% premium for self and up to three enrolled dependants; published whole-dollar per-person premiums apply. The employer pays 60% with the published 1.56 average dependant factor. The declaration is independent of contract salary and retains its effective dates. 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 and 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?PCode=D0050090) — the government pays 100% (極重度/重度), 50% (中度) or 25% (輕度) of a disabled person's own premium; 全民健康保險法 §27(1)(1) makes each dependant's 30% their own (被保險人及其眷屬自付), so each disabled dependant's per-person premium is subsidised on its own (elections `disability_subsidy`, `dependants_subsidised_*`). 全民健康保險法施行細則 §52: premiums are paid in whole dollars, 角以下四捨五入, and where the self-paid premium and the government subsidy both end in five 角 the subsidy rounds up (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=L0060002) — so each person's subsidy is round(per-person premium × share, 1, 'HALF_UP') and the worker pays the rest. The supplementary premium is outside the subsidy: 補助辦法 §4–5 subsidise the insured person's own 自付保險費, and NHIA applies it by deducting it in the monthly premium billing (健保費開計作業中予以扣減補助 — NHIA 各級政府辦理保險對象健保費補助項目一覽表, updated 115-09-17, https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/cp-4721-0d598-2645-1.html); the §31 supplementary premium is withheld at the payment, not billed there, so it carries none (inference from the two; the former municipal citation replaced 2026-09-28). Sources: https://www.nhi.gov.tw/en/cp-68-8652f-35-2.html ; https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/cp-4516-74b0f-2613-1.html (URLs corrected 2026-09-28; both open)

elections.label: 育嬰留職停薪續保 (parental-leave continuation)
elections.description: 性別平等工作法 §16(2): 受僱者於育嬰留職停薪期間，得繼續參加原有之社會保險，原由雇主負擔之保險費，免予繳納；原由受僱者負擔之保險費，得遞延三年繳納. Record it on the declaration dated for the 育嬰留職停薪 period when the worker applied to continue (育嬰留職停薪實施辦法 §2(2)(5)): CONTINUED, or DEFERRED where the worker chose to pay their own share up to three years later. Either way payroll charges nothing for those days: the employer's share is not payable (the government bears it, BLI FAQ https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006915.html), and the insurer bills the worker's own share to the worker directly (勞保局: 寄出…育嬰續保保險費繳款單予被保險人繳納, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/20250/; 健保署: 繳款單由健保署寄發被保險人). NONE, the default, is no continuation: continuation is only on the worker's application (§16(2) 得繼續參加; 實施辦法 §2(2)(5)), so a worker not on the leave, or one who did not apply, is NONE.

name: Labor Pension (勞工退休金, new system)
authority: Labor Pension Act articles 7–9, 14, 15 and 18. The employer contributes at least 6% of the declared monthly contribution wage (election `employer_rate`, default 6; §14(1) 不得低於 6%, so a higher declared rate is priced as declared). A national continuously employed by the same unit before 1 July 2005 may retain the LSA old pension system under articles 8–9, with the 2005 election or deemed continuation and same-unit history evidenced by the nonregistration declaration; the LSA section 56 employer reserve still applies. An employee may voluntarily contribute up to 6%; the default is no voluntary contribution. Apply the declared grade and covered days on a thirty-day month, rounding after proration. A February departure on the last day completes thirty contribution days. name: Resident income tax withholding (薪資所得扣繳)
authority: 所得稅法 article 88; 各類所得扣繳率標準 article 2; 薪資所得扣繳辦法 articles 6–7. Resident regular salary is assessed on the full month's payments, separately from non-monthly bonus payments. The table method requires a dated declaration reference and the declared spouse/dependant count. Family records do not grant table exemptions. Without the declaration, article 6 requires 5%; an explicit 5% election also uses that method. The 5% method truncates tax to whole NT dollars before applying the NT$2,000 exemption; NT$40,020 is the first whole-dollar salary requiring withholding. The table method uses the 114年度 table (台財稅字第11304679670號函): NT$97,000 personal exemption, NT$262,000 married standard deduction and NT$218,000 salary deduction. Published salary bands truncate table tax to NT$10; salaries above NT$500,000 or more than eleven spouse/dependant exemptions use the annualised formula in explanation (3), truncated to NT$1. Current-month voluntary labour pension contributions are excluded once under 勞工退休金條例 article 14(4). Tax fractions below NT$1 are discarded under 各級公庫代理銀行代辦機構及代收稅款機構稅款解繳作業辦法 article 5 (https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL051526). Tax residency must be declared on dated employment terms; citizenship does not determine residence. A mainland-area resident (大陸地區人民) is resident for withholding only on the stay test of 臺灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例 §25(2) and (4) (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=Q0010001&flno=25): 居留、停留合計滿一百八十三日 in the tax year takes the resident table or 5% method; under 183 days the payer withholds at payment at the non-resident salary rates (18%, or 6% up to 1.5 × the minimum wage), per §25(5)–(6) and the MOF answer NM11BZY (updated 115-04-10); no domicile route applies. Cited in place 2026-09-29 (a citation omission, same rule in every version); the declared residency must rest on that day count. https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw/etwmain/tax-info/understanding/tax-q-and-a/national/individual-income-tax/withheld-rule/rule/NM11BZY a bonus class counts toward INCOME_TAX_BONUS instead of this scheme, so the regular base carries no bonus to subtract.

authority: Labor Insurance Act articles 6, 8, 9, 13–15; Enforcement Rules articles 27, 28-1 and 33. Ordinary-risk premium rate 11.5%, shared 20% employee, 70% employer and 10% government. Salary changes do not automatically change the insured grade; notified adjustments take effect on the first of the following month. elections.label: Employment insurance salary
elections.description: Enter the insurer-confirmed monthly grade. The registration dates are its effective dates, not the salary-change or notification dates. A change takes effect from the first of the month after the insurer is notified (勞工保險條例 §14(2); 就業保險法 §40; 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §17(3); 勞工退休金條例 §15(2): 自通知之次月一日生效), so a declaration changing it inside continuous cover is refused.

elections.label: Disability premium subsidy (%)
elections.description: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 and 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法: the government pays 100% (極重度/重度), 50% (中度) or 25% (輕度) of the insured worker's own share. Record the percentage on the worker's disability certificate; zero when none.

elections.label: 育嬰留職停薪續保 (parental-leave continuation)
elections.description: 性別平等工作法 §16(2): 受僱者於育嬰留職停薪期間，得繼續參加原有之社會保險，原由雇主負擔之保險費，免予繳納；原由受僱者負擔之保險費，得遞延三年繳納. Record it on the declaration dated for the 育嬰留職停薪 period when the worker applied to continue (育嬰留職停薪實施辦法 §2(2)(5)): CONTINUED, or DEFERRED where the worker chose to pay their own share up to three years later. Either way payroll charges nothing for those days: the employer's share is not payable (the government bears it, BLI FAQ https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006915.html), and the insurer bills the worker's own share to the worker directly (勞保局: 寄出…育嬰續保保險費繳款單予被保險人繳納, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/20250/; 健保署: 繳款單由健保署寄發被保險人). NONE, the default, is no continuation: continuation is only on the worker's application (§16(2) 得繼續參加; 實施辦法 §2(2)(5)), so a worker not on the leave, or one who did not apply, is NONE.

elections.label: Permanent resident outside EI professional and spouse classes
elections.description: Only for a documented permanent resident who is neither an eligible ROC-national spouse nor, from 2026, a foreign professional/special/senior professional. Reference the dated residency, work classification, family-status and BLI noncoverage evidence on NOT_REGISTERED. EI is mandatory for eligible classes. BLI: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006441.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0109624.html

elections.label: EI noncitizen eligibility class
elections.description: A BLI-registered noncitizen must have a qualifying class supported by proof: ROC-national spouse with residence and work right; or from 2026 an eligible foreign professional/special/senior professional holding permanent residence. Permanent residence by itself is not an EI class.
elections.validation_message: A foreign professional enters EI only with permanent residence from 1 January 2026; otherwise record the documented foreign-spouse class or NOT_REGISTERED.

elections.label: EI noncitizen eligibility proof reference
elections.description: Reference the residence and marriage/work evidence, or PR and professional-work evidence supplied to BLI.

elections.label: Foreign worker outside EI eligibility
elections.description: Use only with dated proof that the worker has neither the qualifying ROC-national spouse class nor the permanent-resident foreign-professional class effective from 2026. Record the immigration and work evidence in the non-registration declaration reference. BLI: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006441.html

name: National Health Insurance (全民健康保險)
authority: National Health Insurance Act articles 18, 27, 29 and 30; Enforcement Rules article 52. Regular premiums use the declared insured amount at the month-end insuring unit. The employee pays 30% of the 5.17% premium for self and up to three enrolled dependants; published whole-dollar per-person premiums apply. The employer pays 60% with the published 1.56 average dependant factor. The declaration is independent of contract salary and retains its effective dates. 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 and 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?PCode=D0050090) — the government pays 100% (極重度/重度), 50% (中度) or 25% (輕度) of a disabled person's own premium; 全民健康保險法 §27(1)(1) makes each dependant's 30% their own (被保險人及其眷屬自付), so each disabled dependant's per-person premium is subsidised on its own (elections `disability_subsidy`, `dependants_subsidised_*`). 全民健康保險法施行細則 §52: premiums are paid in whole dollars, 角以下四捨五入, and where the self-paid premium and the government subsidy both end in five 角 the subsidy rounds up (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=L0060002) — so each person's subsidy is round(per-person premium × share, 1, 'HALF_UP') and the worker pays the rest. The supplementary premium is outside the subsidy: 補助辦法 §4–5 subsidise the insured person's own 自付保險費, and NHIA applies it by deducting it in the monthly premium billing (健保費開計作業中予以扣減補助 — NHIA 各級政府辦理保險對象健保費補助項目一覽表, updated 115-09-17, https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/cp-4721-0d598-2645-1.html); the §31 supplementary premium is withheld at the payment, not billed there, so it carries none (inference from the two; the former municipal citation replaced 2026-09-28). Sources: https://www.nhi.gov.tw/en/cp-68-8652f-35-2.html ; https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/cp-4516-74b0f-2613-1.html (URLs corrected 2026-09-28; both open)

name: Resident income tax withholding (薪資所得扣繳)
authority: 所得稅法 article 88; 各類所得扣繳率標準 article 2; 薪資所得扣繳辦法 articles 6–7. Resident regular salary is assessed on the full month's payments, separately from non-monthly bonus payments. The table method requires a dated declaration reference and the declared spouse/dependant count. Family records do not grant table exemptions. Without the declaration, article 6 requires 5%; an explicit 5% election also uses that method. The 5% method truncates tax to whole NT dollars before applying the NT$2,000 exemption; NT$40,020 is the first whole-dollar salary requiring withholding. The table method uses the 115年度 table (台財稅字第11404675280號函): NT$101,000 personal exemption, NT$272,000 married standard deduction and NT$227,000 salary deduction. Published salary bands truncate table tax to NT$10; salaries above NT$500,000 or more than eleven spouse/dependant exemptions use the annualised formula in explanation (3), truncated to NT$1. Current-month voluntary labour pension contributions are excluded once under 勞工退休金條例 article 14(4). Tax fractions below NT$1 are discarded under 各級公庫代理銀行代辦機構及代收稅款機構稅款解繳作業辦法 article 5 (https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL051526). name: Wage arrears fund — covered wages
authority: Labor Standards Act article 28 and BLI wage arrears fund calculation guidance. Covered wages use each worker’s LI-equivalent insured salary, prorated for covered days on a thirty-day calendar. Workers covered only by employment or occupational accident insurance remain included. This assessment records the wage basis; the company fund scheme calculates and rounds the levy once. Source: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0110180.html Insured amounts must be declared separately from contractual wages; changing contract pay does not change the registered grade. name: 職工福利金（薪津扣繳）
authority: 職工福利金條例 §2(1)(3) (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0040001&flno=2, last amended 2015-07-01): 每月於每個職員工人薪津內各扣百分之○‧五 — a worker deduction paid into the entity's 職工福利金, withheld only where the entity records `company.facts.welfare_committee_established` (§1 obliges every enterprise to 提撥 and 辦理職工福利事業; the deduction presupposes the committee and fund that receive it). Temporary workers are included (勞委會 93-02-17 勞福一字第0930006802號函). Owner rule 2026-09-28 defaults (law silent): 薪津 is the month's salary line net of unpaid days (`BASE - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE`), an allowance joining it only where its class lists WELFARE_FUND in `counts_toward`; the deduction is rounded to the 元 half up, as the insurance shares are. It is not excluded from 薪資所得 (所得稅法 §14(1) 第三類 lists no such exclusion), so no tax base subtracts it. The employer's own §2(1)(1)(2)(4) appropriations (capital, 0.05–0.15% of monthly revenue, 20–40% of scrap sales) are entity-level and outside payroll.
